debt_items.title: Bevy play_mode runtime state assertions
debt_items.description: The harness proves entity structure (Name, Transform, components) but does not run the Bevy App / Schedule to verify play_mode semantics. A future cycle should add play_mode runtime tests (e.g. player movement, enemy patrol, pickup collision) using Bevy 0.19's Time and Input systems.
debt_items.resolution: Resolved in g1-step2-player-movement (v0.109.2): PlayerMovementPlugin + player_movement_system in crates/examples-bevy-harness/src/movement.rs; 4 integration tests in tests/player_movement.rs covering ArrowRight/ArrowLeft/no-input + With<PlayerController> filter gating. 4/4 tests pass.

debt_items.title: Gameplay assertions (jump, patrol, pickup)
debt_items.description: The harness intentionally does not implement gameplay logic (no movement system, no collision system). A Bevy-native game that uses this harness would add these systems; the witness only proves the JSON round-trips.
debt_items.source: v1.0-stabilization evidence-map G1 description (gameplay not required, only structural correctness)
